commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; echo source_head=$(git rev-parse origin/main); SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test "$SERIAL" = RFCT70L7E8J; PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); echo pid_now=$PID; test "$PID" = 24851; FILE=cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye test -s "$FILE"; then echo export_present=1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -l "$FILE"; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat "$FILE" > /tmp/tracker-current-export-late.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, hashlib, os
p='/tmp/tracker-current-export-late.json'
b=open(p,'rb').read(); d=json.loads(b)
s=d['fieldMvpDiagnostics']['scanner']; i=s['ingest']
print('export_bytes='+str(len(b))); print('export_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
for k in ['state','startedAt','lastBleSeenAt']: print(f'{k}={s.get(k)}')
for k in ['rawBleCallbacksTotal','enqueueAcceptedTotal','enqueueRejectedTotal','queueDroppedTotal','coalescedTotal','processingStartedTotal','processingSucceededTotal','processingFailedTotal','signalSamplesWrittenTotal','signalSampleWriteFailuresTotal','queueDepth','queueHighWaterMark','maxQueueWaitMs','maxProcessingDurationMs']: print(f'{k}={i.get(k)}')
raw=i['rawBleCallbacksTotal']; accepted=i['enqueueAcceptedTotal']; rejected=i['enqueueRejectedTotal']; coalesced=i['coalescedTotal']; started=i['processingStartedTotal']; succeeded=i['processingSucceededTotal']; failed=i['processingFailedTotal']
assert raw>0; assert raw==accepted+coalesced+rejected; assert rejected==0; assert i['queueDroppedTotal']==0; assert failed==0; assert i['signalSampleWriteFailuresTotal']==0; assert i['queueDepth']==0; assert started==succeeded+failed; assert accepted==started; assert i['signalSamplesWrittenTotal']>0
print('CURRENT_INGEST_ACCOUNTING_PASS')
PY
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye cp databases/tracker_database cache/tracker-late-final.db; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat cache/tracker-late-final.db > /tmp/tracker-late-final.db; sqlite3 /tmp/tracker-late-final.db 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;' | sed 's/^/db=/' ; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
d=json.load(open('/tmp/tracker-current-export-late.json')); c=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/tracker-late-final.db'); dev=c.execute('select count(*) from devices').fetchone()[0]; sam=c.execute('select count(*) from signal_samples').fetchone()[0]; print('export_deviceCount='+str(d.get('deviceCount'))); print('export_sampleCount='+str(d.get('sampleCount'))); print('db_devices='+str(dev)); print('db_samples='+str(sam)); assert d.get('deviceCount')==dev; assert d.get('sampleCount')==sam; print('EXPORT_DB_RECONCILIATION_PASS')
PY
else echo export_present=0; exit 4; fi
